sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home
hint: First conditional: If + present, will + base verb
explanation: Primera condicional para posibilidades reales: If + presente simple, will + forma base.

sentence: I would travel the world if I had more money
hint: Second conditional: would + base verb, if + past simple
explanation: Segunda condicional para lo hipotético: would + base (no 'will'). If + pasado simple.

sentence: If you study hard, you will pass the exam
explanation: Primera condicional: posibilidad real. If + presente, will + base.

sentence: She would buy a house if she earned more
explanation: Segunda condicional: hipotética. 'Would' (no 'will') + if + pasado simple.

sentence: If we leave now, we will arrive on time
explanation: Primera condicional: posibilidad real sobre salir ahora.

sentence: If I were you, I would accept the job offer
hint: Use 'were' (not 'was') in second conditional with I/he/she
explanation: En la segunda condicional formal, se usa 'were' para todos los sujetos: 'If I were you'.

sentence: We will miss the bus if we do not hurry
explanation: Primera condicional con la cláusula de resultado primero: 'We will miss...if we don't hurry'.

sentence: If he spoke better English, he would get the promotion
explanation: Segunda condicional: If + pasado simple ('spoke'), would + forma base.

sentence: If the weather is nice, we will have a picnic
explanation: Primera condicional: If + presente simple, will + forma base.

sentence: I would learn to play the piano if I had time
explanation: Segunda condicional con la cláusula de resultado primero.

sentence: If she calls me, I will tell her the news
explanation: Primera condicional: If + presente ('calls'), will + base ('tell').

sentence: They would move to the countryside if they could
explanation: Segunda condicional: 'would move' + 'if they could' (no 'can' — se necesita la forma en pasado).

sentence: If you do not water the plants, they will die
explanation: Primera condicional con cláusula 'if' en negativo.

sentence: If I lived near the beach, I would swim every day
explanation: Segunda condicional: If + pasado ('lived'), would + base ('swim').

sentence: We will go to the park if it stops raining
explanation: Primera condicional con la cláusula de resultado primero.

sentence: If they offered me the position, I would take it
explanation: Segunda condicional: If + pasado ('offered'), would + base ('take').

sentence: If you eat too much, you will feel sick
explanation: Primera condicional para consecuencias generales.

sentence: She would be happier if she changed her job
explanation: Segunda condicional: 'would be' + if + pasado ('changed').

sentence: If I see him at the meeting, I will give him your message
explanation: Primera condicional: If + presente ('see'), will + base ('give').

sentence: If we had a bigger house, we would invite more friends
explanation: Segunda condicional: If + pasado ('had'), would + base ('invite').
